Ruby Tuesday Deal Menu: Save on Lunch and Dinner Every Day at This Popular Restaurant

When it comes to finding the best restaurant deals every day of the week, Ruby Tuesday never disappoints. Whether you’re craving a fresh salad, a juicy burger, tender ribs, or a hearty rib eye, the Ruby Tuesday daily deals are here to help you enjoy a delicious meal without breaking the bank. This detailed guide covers everything you need to know about the Ruby Tuesday menu, specials, pricing, and insider tips to help you save on lunch or dinner when you dine-in at your nearest location.

Why RubyTuesday Stands Out for Daily Deals

Ruby Tuesday is a well-known American restaurant chain famous for its family-friendly atmosphere, affordable daily deals, and a diverse menu that includes everything from the iconic Endless Garden Bar to flame-grilled steaks, ribs, burgers, and crispy chicken sandwiches. Whether you visit for lunch or dinner, there’s always a way to save on lunch or dinner with daily specials available every day of the week.

An Overview of Ruby Tuesday Daily Specials

Ruby Tuesday’s daily specials are designed to help guests get maximum value. These deals vary by location but usually include:

  • Lunch Specials: Affordable combos with burgers, sandwiches, or fresh salads.

  • Dinner Deals: Steak or rib entrées with sides and salad bar access.

  • Garden Bar Specials: The Endless Garden Bar is a guest favorite, letting you build your own salad with fresh greens and toppings.

  • Combo Deals: Burger or sandwich with fries or tots and a drink.

  • Limited-Time Offers: Seasonal deals like Nashville Hot Crispy Chicken or Hickory Bourbon BBQ Ribs.

The Ruby Tuesday Menu – Fresh Flavors for Every Day

Ruby Tuesday’s menu is built around variety. Here are some highlights you’ll find when you visit this popular restaurant:

Garden Bar – Choose Your Greens Every Day

One of the best-known features at Ruby Tuesday is the Endless Garden Bar. This salad bar is available every day of the week, giving guests endless combinations of fresh veggies, greens, toppings, cheeses, and dressings.

Menu Pricing Table – Endless Garden Bar

Item Price
Endless Garden Bar Entree $10.99
Add Garden Bar to Any Meal +$3.99
Kids’ Garden Bar $5.99

Choose Your Greens: Build your own fresh salad with options like romaine, spring mix, baby spinach, and crisp iceberg lettuce. Top it off with cheeses, crunchy toppings, fresh veggies, pico de gallo, and signature sauces.

Rib Specials – Slow Cooked for Hours

If you love ribs, Ruby Tuesday has you covered. Their ribs are slow cooked for hours and finished with your choice of rub or sauce.

Popular Rib Options:

  • Half-Rack BBQ Ribs – Coated with house Hickory Bourbon BBQ sauce.

  • Texas Dry Rub Ribs – Rubbed with a Texas-style dry rub for a smoky flavor.

  • Chili Lime Rub Ribs – Finished with a zesty chili lime rub for a spicy kick.

Menu Pricing Table – Rib Specials

Item Price
Half-Rack BBQ Ribs $15.99
Full-Rack BBQ Ribs $21.99
Rib Combo (Ribs + Garden Bar) $19.99

Ruby Tuesday Burger Deals – Patties Topped with American Cheese

Ruby Tuesday burgers are a must-try for burger fans. The American Smashed Burger is a classic, with juicy beef patties topped with American cheese on a toasted brioche bun.

Top Burger Options:

  • Ruby’s Cheeseburger – A juicy beef burger with lettuce, tomato, pickles, onions, and American cheese.

  • American Smashed Burger – Smashed patties, melted cheese, signature sauce.

  • Bacon Cheeseburger – Extra smoky bacon and cheese.

Menu Pricing Table – Burgers

Burger Price Comes With
Ruby’s Cheeseburger $11.99 Fries or Tots
American Smashed Burger $12.49 Fries or Tots
Bacon Cheeseburger $12.99 Fries or Tots
Double Stack Burger $13.99 Fries or Tots

All burgers are served with crispy fries or tots and can be upgraded with sides like the Endless Garden Bar.

Rib Eye & Steak – Premium Cuts for Dinner

Craving steak for dinner? Try the 6 oz Rib Eye or a larger cut, seasoned with Texas Dry Rub or classic steak seasoning.

Popular Steak Options:

  • 6 oz Rib Eye – Juicy and flavorful, cooked to order.

  • Hickory Bourbon Rib Eye – Brushed with smoky BBQ sauce.

  • Steak & Garden Bar Combo – Steak plus the Endless Garden Bar.

Menu Pricing Table – Steaks

Steak Option Price
6 oz Rib Eye $18.99
Hickory Bourbon Rib Eye $19.99
Steak & Garden Bar Combo $21.99

Below is a sample of Ruby Tuesday daily deals you may find at participating locations. Always check with your local restaurant for up-to-date specials.

Lunch Deals – Save on Lunch Every Day

If you’re planning a lunch break at Ruby Tuesday, you can take advantage of wallet-friendly combos and quick bites.

Popular Lunch Combos

  • Lunch Burger Combo – Burger + fries or tots + drink.

  • Sandwich & Salad Combo – Half sandwich with Garden Bar.

  • Crispy Chicken Sandwich – Crispy chicken on toasted brioche bun.

  • Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich – Spicy, crispy, and flavorful.

Lunch Deal Pricing Table

Combo Price
Lunch Burger Combo $9.99
Sandwich & Salad $10.99
Crispy Chicken Sandwich $8.99

These lunch specials are designed to get you in and out fast while letting you enjoy fresh, satisfying food.

Dinner Deals – Hearty Meals for Less

Ruby Tuesday’s dinner deals bring families and friends together. From ribs to steak to burgers, there’s something for everyone.

Dinner Favorites

  • Hickory Bourbon BBQ Ribs – Sweet, smoky flavor.

  • 6 oz Rib Eye Dinner – Tender steak with side and salad bar.

  • Endless Garden Bar Entree – Light but filling.

  • American Smashed Burger Dinner – With fries or tots.

Dinner Deal Pricing Table

Dinner Price
Hickory Bourbon BBQ Ribs $17.99
6 oz Rib Eye Dinner $18.99
Garden Bar Entree $10.99

Appetizers & Sides – Start Your Meal Right

Don’t skip the starters! Ruby Tuesday’s appetizers are perfect for sharing.

Popular Appetizers

  • Spinach Artichoke Dip

  • Chicken Wings (Buffalo or BBQ)

  • Mozzarella Sticks

  • Loaded Cheese Fries

Pair these with any meal to complete your dine-in experience.

Specials for Families – Big Meals for Less

Ruby Tuesday is also a favorite for families. Many locations offer Family Meal Deals to feed 4–6 people at a discount.

Family Favorites

  • Burger Family Bundle – 4 beef burgers with fries or tots.

  • Rib Family Bundle – Half racks of ribs + sides.

  • Garden Bar for 4 – Takeout or dine-in options.

How to Find Ruby Tuesday Deals Near You

To find out exactly what’s on special every day of the week, visit the official Ruby Tuesday website or check with your local restaurant. Some locations may have regional specials or limited-time offers.

Tips to Save More When You Dine-In

Sign Up for the Ruby Tuesday Rewards

Joining Ruby Tuesday’s rewards program is a smart way to get exclusive coupons, a free burger on your birthday, and special deals every day.

Take Advantage of Happy Hour

Many Ruby Tuesday locations offer a Happy Hour with discounts on appetizers and drinks.

Check Online for Coupons

Ruby Tuesday frequently posts printable coupons or online codes for extra savings.

New Menu Items and Seasonal Specials

Ruby Tuesday updates its menu often, so keep an eye out for new additions like:

  • Crispy Chicken with Nashville Hot Rub

  • New Hickory Bourbon BBQ Combos

  • Seasonal Garden Bar Ingredients

  • New Appetizer Platters

Ruby Tuesday for All Occasions

From quick lunches to family dinners, date nights, or casual celebrations, Ruby Tuesday’s daily deals and affordable menu make it a go-to restaurant every day of the week.

Final Thoughts – Enjoy Ruby Tuesday Daily Deals

Whether you’re craving a classic burger with American cheese and crispy fries, tender ribs slow cooked for hours with your choice of rub, or the freshness of the Endless Garden Bar, Ruby Tuesday has a deal to make your visit satisfying and affordable. Next time you’re planning lunch or dinner, remember to check out Ruby Tuesday’s daily specials, sign up for rewards, and enjoy fresh, delicious meals every day.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are Ruby Tuesday daily deals available for takeout?

Some specials are dine-in only, but many locations offer family bundles and limited deals for takeout.

Is the Endless Garden Bar available every day?

Yes! The Garden Bar is available every day of the week and can be added to any meal or enjoyed as an entree.

Does Ruby Tuesday offer vegetarian options?

Absolutely. The Endless Garden Bar, veggie burgers, and sides offer plenty of meatless choices.

Visit Ruby Tuesday Today

So, if you’re searching for a tasty deal, a fresh salad, a hearty steak, or a juicy burger topped with American cheese, Ruby Tuesday is ready to welcome you. Bring your family or friends, enjoy the daily deals, and make every meal a reason to celebrate.

Whether it’s lunch, dinner, or any day in between – Ruby Tuesday is your spot to dine-in, relax, and enjoy specials every day of the week.
